title: 대법관후보추천위원회 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:8:0:00008:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 8 (Examination and Recommendation of Candidates)
(1) Deleted on May 29, 2018.
(2) Among the nominees under Article 7 (2) whom the Recommendation Committee considers suitable as candidates, the Committee shall examine their qualifications for service as Justices of the Supreme Court and recommend as candidates those found qualified. Provided, however, that where a nominator intentionally seeks to exert undue influence on the examination by violating the nomination procedures under Article 6, such as by publicly nominating a person, the Committee may, by resolution, exclude that person from examination. [Amended on May 29, 2018.]
(3) The number of candidates recommended by the Recommendation Committee under paragraph (2) shall be at least three times the number of persons to be recommended for appointment. [Amended on May 29, 2018.]
(4) The Chairperson shall notify the Chief Justice of the Supreme Court in writing of the recommendations under paragraph (2) immediately after the meeting ends. [Amended on May 29, 2018.]
(5) Notwithstanding Article 5 (4), the Recommendation Committee shall disclose the list of candidates.
